searchText: It will be in few months, stay tuned for when we announce the date and open applications 🙂 I just managed to watch the presentations from Denver, I wanted to congratulate all fellows, their respective mentors, and the organizers of the program that it's getting better on each iteration. Some very exciting ideas were presented in that video!
